channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Musk: AI5 Chip Goes to Optimus as Tesla Cars Stay on AI4
item.description: Elon Musk says AI5 will go to Optimus while cars remain on AI4, as FSD v15's Reality View shows what a 1B-parameter diffusion model can do on today's hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LeCun Answers Musk's Superintelligence Claim: No Level-5 Driving, No Robot to Match an 8-Year-Old
item.description: After Musk declared superintelligence over a claimed Riemann hypothesis proof, Yann LeCun pointed to driving, robots and cats as the problems AI still has not solved.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: RoboStore Adds AGIBOT to Its U.S. Lineup, With Humanoids From $29,999
item.description: Unitree's U.S. distributor now lists AGIBOT's X2, A3 and G2 humanoids, but its announcement doesn't say how the robots fit under the FCC's foreign-robot rules.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: South Korea's Base Group Plans $150 Million Lifeline for Foundation
item.description: Seoul-based Base Group is preparing to invest $150 million in Foundation, which has not paid staff since October 30, Reuters reports. The deal would deepen Base's ties to the Trump family, which Democratic senators questioned in August.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: OpenAI Folds Its Robotics Team Into Research as GPT-6 Astra Takes On Robot Control
item.description: Six months after launching OpenAI Robotics, the company has moved its robotics researchers under Mark Chen and its hardware teams under Greg Brockman, saying general models like GPT-6 Astra can run robots directly.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Apptronik's RL Lead Says Legs, Not Wheels, Make Robots Safe to Work Beside
item.description: Kyle Morgenstein argues the "fits in human spaces" case for humanoids is really about safety: legs keep a robot compliant with small actuators, while wheeled bases carry large reflected inertia.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: 1X Will Ship NEO to Developers in December, Plans Weekly Leaderboard and Live Robot Runs
item.description: At Runtime 2026, Bernt Børnich said NEO ships in December to developers and some consumers, with a sensor-matched data collection rig, an automated training pipeline, open APIs, a Discord community and a Friday leaderboard streamed on Twitch.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Sets November 25 AI Day in Guangzhou, Promises New IRON Capabilities
item.description: He Xiaopeng says the event will focus on how AI models and physical systems evolve together, with IRON interacting live on stage weeks before its mass-production target.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: NJIT's PHD-Hand Uses Linkages, Not Tendons, in a Humanoid Hand You Can Print for Under $650
item.description: NJIT researchers built PHD-Hand, a 570 g, 3D-printable humanoid hand with 15 linkage-driven joints and a parts cost under $650. The paper is accepted at IEEE Humanoids 2026, and the design will be open-sourced.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: IntelliProve Raises €2.7M to Bring Camera-Based Vital Signs to Humanoid Robots
item.description: The Belgian startup reads heart rate, breathing and blood pressure from a 30-second face scan with an ordinary camera. After building it into virtual-care apps in 50+ countries, it now wants the same software running on humanoid and assistive robots.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GlobalFoundries Becomes First Chipmaker to Test Boston Dynamics' Atlas
item.description: GlobalFoundries joins the Atlas early adopter program, the first customer from outside the car industry, with onsite testing from early 2027. It is also spreading Spot to fabs in New York, Dresden and Singapore, where two robots have logged 90,000 inspections since April.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Humanoids Summit Confirms Tesla Optimus for December Event, but Not Reservations
item.description: Humanoids Summit says Tesla will bring Optimus and FSD demo drives to its December 1–2 San Mateo event. The release does not mention the Optimus reservations or Gen 3 appearance its founder linked to the summit in October.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Brett Adcock Hopes Figure Robots Can Work in Any Home Within Six Months
item.description: On Peter Diamandis' Moonshots podcast, Figure's CEO gave a home timeline after showing Helix 3, put BotQ capacity at about 40,000 robots a year, and said the world ran out of compute in September.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: This Week in Humanoids: Genesis AI’s $500M, Apollo’s Big Week and Foundation’s Missed Payroll
item.description: Our November 17 newsletter covers Genesis AI’s Series A, Gemini Robotics 2.5 and GXO’s Apollo plan, Jensen Huang’s exit, Foundation’s payroll and first humanoids from Genki and ASUS.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen Takes Over From Gemini Robotics ER 2 as Google Launches a Robotics Plugin for Antigravity
item.description: Google says its cheaper Gemini 4 model beats Gemini Robotics ER 2 on embodied reasoning and scores 58 on AA-Robotics. A new Antigravity plugin sets up an arm over USB, builds MuJoCo sims from chat and runs the same code on hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Mimic Robotics Previews FLUX-mimic-x, Claiming the Top RoboLab Score for Real-Time Robot Policies
item.description: The 7B Video-Action Model, built on Black Forest Labs' FLUX 3, scores 51.4% on NVIDIA's RoboLab in Mimic's own chart. No paper, blog post or weights have been published yet.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Genesis AI Raises $500M Series A at $3.5B Valuation as Eno Heads Into Production
item.description: Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures and Eclipse co-led the round, with NVIDIA, AMD Ventures and Samsung Next joining. Genesis says the money will scale Eno deployments, data collection and training.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: How Frontier Language Models Are Speeding Up Robotics Research
item.description: From a vibe-coded motion tracker to Argon reviewing robot failures and Astra steering GR00T 2, language models now sit in several parts of the robot-learning loop. Most of the fastest gains are still in simulation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: FORT Robotics, Safety Supplier to Agility, Posts 52% Revenue Growth in S-4 Ahead of Nasdaq Listing
item.description: FORT, which supplies safety systems for Digit, reported $12.5 million in nine-month revenue and an $8.0 million loss as it heads for Nasdaq at a $500 million valuation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Robotera Opens Orders for XHAND 1 Pro-U, the Hand in NVIDIA's GR00T 2 DexUMI Demos
item.description: Robotera's 16-DoF XHAND 1 Pro-U mirrors NVIDIA's DexUMI exoskeleton joint for joint. It ran the GR00T 2 yogurt, granola and match-lighting demos at CoRL, and the first run is 40 units.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LG Signs With Korea's Robot Certification Agency to Safety-Test Its Humanoids
item.description: LG Electronics and KIRIA will put CLOiD through a pilot safety certification and build the evaluation system for Korea's first humanoid safety certification centre in Daegu.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Foundation Misses Payroll After CEO Borrowed $4.6 Million to Buy a Home
item.description: Foundation Future Industries has not paid staff since October 30, CNBC reports, after CEO Sankaet Pathak borrowed $4.6 million from the company in 2025. Sources also say its $24 million in Pentagon contracts came with the Boardwalk Robotics acquisition.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: After SuperMimic, Open-Source Humanoid Motion Trackers Now Train in Minutes on One GPU
item.description: A UC Berkeley paper released without code set off a run of community reimplementations. InstantTrack, BlinkMimic and XMimic cut Unitree G1 tracker training on a 40-clip benchmark to a few minutes, in simulation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: ASUS Unveils Gallop, Its First Humanoid Robot, Already Packing Parts on Its Own Production Line
item.description: The two-armed robot runs on NVIDIA Jetson Thor and learns from head-camera footage of ASUS factory workers. Partner pilots start in 2027, with a market launch targeted for the second half of 2028.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Andy Rubin's Genki Robotics Shows Its Humanoid to Japan's Prime Minister
item.description: Genki Robotics, the Tokyo startup founded by Android creator Andy Rubin, showed its humanoid for the first time at Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's physical AI meeting. The unit walked for the first time three days earlier, and Genki plans an open Android-style platform built on Japanese hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: J.P. Morgan Forecasts 300,000 to 400,000 US-Made Humanoids by 2030
item.description: The bank says supply, not demand, limits the pace, puts humanoid costs near labor parity and favors component suppliers such as Timken, ROBOTIS and Orbbec.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as NVIDIA CEO; CFO Colette Kress Steps In
item.description: Huang left NVIDIA on Thursday after reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset. The board says the product roadmap, including its robotics work, continues without interruption.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Agile Robots Raises $500 Million Series F at $8.5 Billion Valuation
item.description: SoftBank led the round, with NVIDIA and Hitachi joining, as the Munich company plans US expansion and more production capacity in Germany.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: GXO Signs Letter of Intent for Up to 1,000 Apptronik Apollo Humanoids
item.description: GXO and Apptronik will expand Apollo warehouse trials from 2027 under a Robotics-as-a-Service framework, and intend to roll out up to 1,000 robots over four years if agreed KPIs are met.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Six AGIBOT G2 Robots Complete 1,730 Tasks in 24-Hour Shanghai Convenience Store Trial
item.description: Four of the six robots pass a performance assessment as the trial puts customer service, retail operations and embodied AI capabilities to the test in a working store.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
